name: Aero Trujillo-Appiah
role: Chop shop operator and stolen vehicle parts broker in the Undertow
location: The Undertow — runs a legitimate-front vehicle repair bay called Undertow Mechanical in a reclaimed flood-tunnel structure near the Escanaba Gateway approach, near Michigan Ave and Roosevelt
description:
Aero Trujillo-Appiah has the particular physical presence of someone who has spent twenty years doing heavy manual work and developed an architecture around it — wide through the shoulders, with grease-dark hands that are never entirely clean and forearms marked by old burn-scars from a welding accident in their early twenties. Their skin is a warm brown with amber undertones, their hair is worn in a practical short wrap they cover with a work cap on the floor. Their eyes are standard brown but they have bioluminescent skin mods along their forearms and collarbones — a blue-green that pulses faintly in low light, visible when their sleeves roll up, which in the shop is always. It's a purely aesthetic choice that amuses them because people expect something more threatening from someone who looks like them.

Mircea runs a genuinely good mechanical shop. This is not a front in the sense of being hollow — they can and do repair vehicles legitimately, and their legitimate work is skilled. The chop operation runs alongside it, not instead of it, which is part of why they've lasted. They are patient, methodical, and have the institutional memory of everyone who has moved parts through the Undertow in the past decade. They are neither warm nor cold to most people — professional, honest about prices, honest about timelines, and unwilling to pretend that the boundary between legal and not is meaningful when Ferrogate Transit controls the licensing structure for vehicle repair anyway.

core_fears: A major fire or flood taking the shop — they have put twenty years into that structure
Being forced to take sides in a territorial dispute between the networks they broker for
core_desires: To keep the shop running, self-directed, accountable to no one specific
To eventually own the tunnel structure outright rather than leasing from an Undertow landlord
coping_mechanisms: Physical work as emotional regulation — if Mircea is upset they are in the bay doing something difficult with their hands
Blunt pragmatism as a shield against sentimentality
blind_spots: They genuinely do not think much about the downstream effects of the parts they move — someone's stripped Ferrogate Transit maintenance drone becomes abstract to them immediately after the transaction
psychology.secret: The welding accident twenty years ago wasn't entirely an accident — they were covering for a then-partner's mistake in their first chop operation and stepped into the arc instead of letting the partner take the blame. The partner is now a mid-level figure in one of the Stockyard crews Mircea brokers for, and neither of them has ever mentioned it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical vehicle and mechanical terminology, Undertow vernacular, blunt declarative sentences — they do not use three words when one will do
speech_patterns.cadence: Flat and even, with long silences that are thinking rather than discomfort. Doesn't modulate for social comfort.
verbal_tics: Naming the specific part or component before discussing it — never general terms when specific ones exist
'That's a different conversation' when something goes outside their lane
example_lines: 'Ferrogate Transit Series 9 drive assembly. Clean pull, no cracks in the housing. I'll move it for Φ340 or I won't move it at all. What I won't do is hold it for two weeks while you find a buyer.'
'I fix things. I move things. I don't ask what happened before they got here. That's a different conversation.'

story_hooks: A vehicle came in through one of their theft crews with something in the cargo compartment that the crew didn't notice and Mircea absolutely did — now they have a decision to make about it
The Undertow landlord who owns their tunnel structure has sold to a Ringo corponation subsidiary that wants the space for a transit staging area — Mircea has sixty days
narrative_function: Parts broker and information source for the Undertow's vehicle ecosystem — knows what's moving, what's being stripped, and who needs what. Can supply vehicles, parts, or transport connections. Morally uncomplicated in their own view, which makes them useful and unpredictable.
augmentations: Bioluminescent skin mods — forearm and collarbone panels, blue-green (cosmetic). A structural joint reinforcement in both wrists — they were damaged in the welding accident and the augmentation was the affordable fix. Optical magnification implant in the right eye for fine mechanical work.
daily_life: Opens the bay at 0800. Legitimate work during business hours with one or two assistants present. After 1900 when the assistants leave, they evaluate incoming stripped parts, run serial number matching and provenance checks to avoid hot inventory, and process orders for their broker clients.
affiliation: Independent — pays tribute to the Undertow's loose protection arrangement; has a long-standing parts-sourcing relationship with two Stockyard theft crews

decision_rules: No hot inventory with active Ferrogate Transit flags — too traceable, not worth it
Both sides of the operation maintain real quality — the legitimate work is genuinely good
Never extend credit on parts — payment first, parts after
escalation_ladder: Declines the job with a price too high to be accepted
Declines the job with no counter-offer
Closes the bay early and goes dark on comms
Calls in a favor with the Stockyard crews if physical presence is needed

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally neutral — assesses competence immediately and treats people according to it rather than warmth
interpersonal_modes.friends: Not many, but fiercely reliable — shows up, keeps promises, doesn't say much about it

stress_responses.medium: Visibly slows down and becomes extremely precise — this is them managing the urge to act rashly
stress_responses.high: Goes completely quiet and into a kind of operational mode that people who know them find alarming

contradictions: Proud of the legitimate work and its quality even though it's partly a cover
Claims not to have loyalties but would take significant personal risk to protect the two or three people they actually trust
habits: Runs calibration checks on their wrist joints and optical implant every morning before starting work
Bioluminescent panels pulse faster when they're interested or focused — involuntary tell
Leaves an oily thumbprint on every finished work order, which they claim is habit and is actually a signature
breaking_points: Someone threatening or damaging the shop — it is an extension of their body at this point
Being lied to about what a vehicle was used for before it came to them — they expect abstraction, not deception

physical_description.heritage: Multi-continental ancestry with Sub-Saharan African (30.5%), East Asian (25.4%), and Middle Eastern (18.0%) as primary components, blended with Hispanic/Latin American (13.3%), Southeast Asian (6.7%), and Indigenous American (6.1%) heritage. This creates a striking fusion: deep warm undertones from African ancestry combine with the angular cheekbones and eye shape of East Asian genetics, while Middle Eastern features add definition to facial structure. Hispanic and Southeast Asian ancestry softens the angularity with fuller cheeks and lip fullness, while Indigenous American heritage contributes to the overall warmth and earth-toned complexion. The resulting phenotype is distinctly cosmopolitan—warm-toned with sophisticated bone structure that reflects the true Ubiquitous Diaspora.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and compact through the torso, built from two decades of heavy mechanical work — dense muscle without bulk, with weathered forearms that speak to repetitive strain and controlled strength
physical_description.hair_style: Practical short wrap, typically covered with a work cap on the shop floor
physical_description.eye_color: Deep brown with subtle East Asian shape; right eye contains faint magnification lens visible on close inspection
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm brown with golden undertones—a luminous medium-deep complexion that reflects the warm heritage of Sub-Saharan, East Asian, Middle Eastern, and Indigenous American ancestry, catching bioluminescent light with distinctive clarity
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and pragmatic — minimal grooming beyond functional maintenance. Face shows the patient set of someone accustomed to long problem-solving. High, prominent cheekbones reflecting East Asian and Middle Eastern ancestry blend with the fuller features and fuller lips of Sub-Saharan and Southeast Asian heritage, softened further by Hispanic and Indigenous American ancestry proportions. Hands perpetually stained with grease and machine oil despite regular washing; creases around the eyes from squinting at fine mechanical detail. Facial structure shows the sophisticated angularity of Middle Eastern features softened by the warmth and roundness of African, Southeast Asian, Hispanic, and Indigenous American proportions.
distinguishing_marks: Twin parallel burn scars running down both forearms from wrist to mid-forearm, pale and smooth from two-decade-old welding accident
Bioluminescent skin modification panels along both forearms (inner and outer) in blue-green, visible when sleeves roll up, pulsing faintly in low light
Bioluminescent modification along the collarbones in matching blue-green, visible at the neck when shirt collar is open
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent subcutaneous panels on forearms and collarbones (blue-green, aesthetic). Structural wrist augmentation visible as subtle reinforcement plating at both wrists when hands are examined closely. Right eye contains optical magnification lens (subtle but detectable on direct eye contact, faint crystalline structure within the iris)
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and deliberate — no wasted motion. Stands with weight balanced, hands often at rest but poised for immediate work. Moves with the patience of someone who has learned that rushing breaks things and ruins margins. Direct eye contact, minimal expressiveness, but not hostile — the affect of someone who communicates primarily through work quality rather than warmth
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 practical — grey or blue NCORP-branded work coveralls or sturdy canvas pants with reinforced knees and pockets. Plain fitted undershirt, usually dark. Heavy-duty work boots (current model: Goodyear Vulcan, resoled twice). Sleeves rolled or cut at forearms to accommodate augmentations and allow light to catch the bioluminescence. Worn canvas work cap with an illegible logo. A single silver ring on the left hand (no obvious sentimentality — looks utilitarian). Grease-stained leather apron when doing detailed work. No jewelry beyond the ring. Clothes carry the authentic patina of shop work — not a costume
